name: Assignment existence
expect: refuses an invented assignment instead of saving its answer

name: Text shape
expect: rejects non-text scribing instead of replacing it with the raw answer

name: Unique nonempty selection
find:
if (!Array.isArray(args.answerIds) || args.answerIds.length === 0
        || new Set(args.answerIds).size !== args.answerIds.length) throw new Error("guided_assignment_answer_ids_invalid");
expect: refuses duplicate or empty answer selections before sending a draft

name: Answer membership
expect: refuses an answer from a different assignment before sending a draft

name: Telegram size bound
expect: refuses to truncate a draft that exceeds Telegram's message size

name: Owner delivery availability

name: No false send receipt on lost acknowledgement

name: Voice tools exposed
